slides.title: Open Items & Disclosure Notes
slides.content:
ITEMS FOR VERBAL DISCLOSURE DURING PRESENTATION

1. CONTINGENCY BUFFER IS TIGHT
At $1,100, the contingency is below the standard 3–5% for a 100-person two-day event. Any scope additions post-signing (AV live-streaming, additional reception hour, floral upgrades, etc.) will require a formal change order and budget amendment.

2. CLEARSIGNAL AV QUOTE EXPIRY — ACTION REQUIRED
ClearSignal's confirmed quote expires 2026-04-15. If Veridian approves this proposal, the AV contract must be executed before that date to hold the $8,000 pricing. Delay risks repricing.

3. AV STREAMING NOT INCLUDED
If live-stream or recording capability is needed, ClearSignal has quoted an add-on of $1,400. This would require a budget amendment.

4. HARVEST TABLE DEPOSIT TIMELINE
Harvest Table requires a 25% deposit ($4,975) to hold the September dates. Quote valid through 2026-04-30.
